design.case_order: For block 0..2, shuffle the listed scenarios with random.Random(991019+block); within each scenario rotate the listed policies by (block+original_scenario_index)%5. Not full counterbalance.

gates: zero wrong effects or premature dependent reads for frontier and frontier_lookup
two independent tasks complete before A resolution in delayed and alias frontier cases
lookup resolves committed-but-unacknowledged A; absent A remains UNKNOWN and does not permit D or A retry
all physical releases empty and retained database/receipt/trace audits pass
median paired frontier/global_wait duration ratio at most 0.8 for delayed+alias, six matched pairs; fixture-only descriptive threshold
stop_rule: Stop on first unexpected per-case audit failure; each block output is created exclusively and consumed once; no rerun of a consumed block.

retained_pre_freeze_failures: Xlib Display is not a context manager
audit Counter(dict) compared timestamp counts rather than key occurrences

scope: Private local Xvfb/Openbox/Tk/XTEST calibration with trusted structured application footprints and receipts. Not Agent Interface runtime integration, not visual grounding, not a Doom/model/formal recovery allocation. Methods derive from established effect-system and concurrency ideas; no global novelty priority claim.
